Knowledge of decision trees and ANOVA technique will be an advantage.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in developing and maintaining measurement metrics and standardized outcome metrics based on business requirements</li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong> PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: (in addition to required)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Analytics, Data sciences, or any quantitative discipline,</li> <li>Experience with ecommerce analytics is a huge plus</li> <li>High proficiency in building Tableau dashboards and executive friendly deliverables for business needs and to aid decision making</li> <li>Proficient in application of Statistical Methods</li> <li>Prior start up experience highly preferred.</li> <li>Knowledge of Ecommerce in any of the areas - supply chain advertising, marketing, merchandising, and store operations is preferred</li> <li>Prior experience with direct client relationships and liaison to understand client needs and scope actionable insights with business impact desirable</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.
